# The Field Guide — Privacy

The trust-graph work behind the Hitchhikers Field Guide — a walking AR client that needed real one-hop trust, met by the ToIP DTG trust-graph work, which had it and had never been near a street. Built 2026-08-13 → 16 on the field farm (`privacy.fieldguide.guide.agentprivacy.ai`), served to the team from the embassy Pis, and merged here 2026-08-17 as the federation's thirteenth site.

## What this is

A counter-spec built as evidence rather than argued as prose: eight suites, 124 properties, every ruling anchored to a test that fails if the ruling is broken.

Start at [[Field Guide Trust Overlay]] — it indexes everything else.

## The rulings

* [[The Meet Rite]] — how an edge is made, in a street, between two phones
* [[Audience Is Granted Not Computed]] — why two hops is nothing, not half
* [[The Pairwise Peer Reference]] — the leak that nearly undid all of it
* [[A Wiki Fork Is Not An Audience]] — publication is not a rung on the ladder
* [[Erosion Is A Rate Not A Cliff]] — a meet from four years ago is not a meet from Tuesday
* [[Shared Quest Is Not Consent]] — where the reply disagrees with something already shipped
* [[The Rejection Register]] — every way the model says no
* [[Rounding Is Not A Detail]] — two correct implementations, one pin, opposite sides of the street

## Answering the pack directly

* [[The Question Map]] — all twenty questions in the ARWorld documents, each anchored to a property that runs
* [[Phase 0 Acceptance]] — the five acceptance criteria, executable
* [[The Overlay Ranking]] — the score-terms table, made mechanical
* [[The ARWorld Pack]] — the source documents themselves
* [[OASIS And The Cred Spec]] · [[The DTG Credentials Core Specification]] · [[The DTG ZKP Task Force]] · [[Could This Be Zero Knowledge]] — the lab side of the reflection

## The record

> I will show you where I stood.
> I will not tell the world I stood anywhere.

Nine of them in [[Proverbs Of The Trust Overlay]], each with the property that would fail if it were broken.

The two days, with the runtime traces beside them: [[2026-08-15 The Predicate Walks To Islington]] · [[2026-08-16 The Checklist Answers Back]].

## Run it yourself

The assets lane carries the workbench — the model, both sides' documents, the conformance vectors, and a captured run report. [[The Working Files]] indexes it. Node and Python standard libraries only; nothing to install, nothing to log into.

## Lineage

`~/field_guide_privacymage` is the **working directory** — the build source of this wiki lane, not a repo. The durable research substance is folded into the corpus: the counter-spec, both checked maps, the notes and the runtimes live at `agentprivacy-docs/research/fieldguide/`; the lab-side filing is exploration X11 in the DTG workbench; the chronicle, the tome act and the graph weave sit in their own repos. Sister copies of this wiki serve the team from the embassy Pis over the tailnet (`mitch.private.fish` · `fieldguide.pi4.private.fish`), pushed as FedWiki *forks* naming their source, so every copy's journal says where it came from.
